full_name: Kathleen J. Stebe | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Kathleen J. Stebe, a professor of chemical engineering at Johns Hopkins University, uses surfactants to control the stress response of liquid-vapor interfaces. Surfactants are molecules that absorb on fluid interfaces and change the surface tension.
